reviews.text:
I really like this product. It is easy to use and looks very nice on the skin.
Overall, I'm happy with this product and would buy it again. I recommend it if you want simple and pretty makeup.
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢件產品。佢好用又上到皮膚好靚。
整體嚟講我對呢件產品好滿意，會再回購。如果你想化簡單又靚嘅妝，我會推薦。

reviews.text:
It was too light than the photo. You could probably build it up on its own. I tried to in the inner corners of my lips with #flower dasique gloss as the base but it did not get dark enough so I used rom&nd peeling angdoo which gave the gradient look. The whole range I would say is best as a base colour but they do not work together well it creates a light gradient if that what u are looking for but if i cant see it and have to be really close to the mirror to be able to tell I would prefer more pigmented.

Products used in photo: heart percent rose beige lipliner/ #flower dasique gloss then the melted berry and rom&nd peeling angdoo
reviews.zh:
同張相比起嚟淺咗好多。單用應該都可以疊到你想要嘅效果。我試過用 #flower dasique gloss 做底喺唇角內側打底，但顏色都係唔夠深，所以最後用咗 rom&nd peeling angdoo 做到漸層效果。整個系列我會覺得最適合用嚟打底，但佢哋之間唔算夾到好靚，雖然可以做出淺色漸層嘅效果，如果你想要嘅係淺漸層就啱，但如果要對住鏡睇好近先睇得出，我就會寧願揀顯色度高啲嘅。

相中用嘅產品：heart percent rose beige lipliner/ #flower dasique gloss 然後 melted berry 同 rom&nd peeling angdoo

reviews.text: Acts like a base colour which it is normally recommended for. Smells really nice. The gloss is clear and glides with a thin layer. I like my lips more defined so I paired it with heart percent rose beige lipliner
reviews.zh: 可以當底色用，一般都係咁建議。味道好香。唇釉係透明嘅，薄薄一層就滑得開。我鍾意唇形再突出啲，所以配 heart percent rose beige 唇線筆一齊用。

reviews.text: I bought this because the package is so cute and when I used it the color is so lovely.But it doesn't stick for very long.
reviews.zh: 買佢係因為個包裝好得意，用落支顏色好靚。但係唔算好持久。

reviews.text: It’s very moist and the light peach scent is lovely! A little on a sticky side.
reviews.zh: 非常水潤，淡淡嘅桃香味好正！係有少少黏笠。

reviews.text: Bought for a friend. The packaging was super cute. Theres a sweet scent to them as well. Not sticky when applied.
reviews.zh: 買俾朋友。包裝超靚。仲有甜甜嘅香味。搽落唔會黐。

reviews.text: This is my favorite gloss!! The pigment isn’t very strong but I actually prefer that compared to other glosses because it enhances the lip colour underneath and adds a cute filter-like finish. The tip of the gloss is firm and won’t move and application is very easy and also doesn’t bring too much product at a time which I found very convenient. The feeling of application feels very light too!! 3+ layers give the viral bunny tongue colour and is so cute!! I got #13 Mauve Grape🥰
reviews.zh: 係我最愛嘅唇釉！！顯色唔算好強，但我反而鍾意呢點，比較過其他唇釉，呢款反而可以帶出底下嘅唇色，加埋一個好似 filter 嘅可愛妝效。唇釉頭夠實，唔會郁，搽起嚟好容易，亦唔會一次帶出太多產品，我覺得好方便。搽嘅感覺都好輕！！疊 3 層以上就有嗰陣流行嘅兔仔舌色，好可愛！！我買咗 #13 Mauve Grape🥰

reviews.text: Super cute packaging but that’s about it. The gloss is thin and very sheer. Pigment is weak and not long-lasting at all. Scent is fruity. Will not repurchase :(
reviews.zh: 包裝超靚但係僅此而已。唇釉偏薄，好通透。顯色弱，幾乎唔持久。味道係水果香。唔會再回購 :(

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
